title: Medical appointment reminder
description: Remind patients about an upcoming appointment with date, time and doctor. Appointment reminder WhatsApp template for clinics.
notes: Never include diagnosis or treatment details in the message; keep it to logistics. Send 24 hours before.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, this is a reminder of your appointment with {{doctor}} at {{clinic}} on {{date}} at {{time}}. Thank you, and reply here if you need anything.
